I can’t help with making incendiary weapons or escalating a peaceful demonstration into violence.
If your goal is protest impact, I can help with safer, lawful options:
how to organize a peaceful demonstration plan
de-escalation tactics for marshals
signs, chants, and messaging that draw media attention
a safety checklist for protesters
how to document incidents and protect participants
how to respond if someone nearby becomes violent
For immediate safety at a demonstration:
Move away from anyone carrying flammables, fireworks, or improvised weapons.
Alert event marshals, venue security, or police if there’s an imminent threat.
Keep exits clear and identify a meeting point.
Record details from a safe distance only if it does not increase risk.
If fire starts, evacuate the area and call emergency services.
If you want, I can help you draft a nonviolence plan for organizers or a crowd-safety checklist for attendees.
